name: @pipeworx/mcp-mi-medical-exclusions

tools.name: mi_medical_check_exclusion
tools.description: Is this healthcare provider sanctioned or excluded from the Michigan Medicaid program? Screens a person or business name, an NPI, and/or a license number against the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) List of Sanctioned Providers, which merges sanctions from MDHHS, its Office of Inspector General, Licensing and Regulatory Affairs and HHS. State-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (leie pack) for Michigan, sibling of il_medical_check_exclusion, tx_medical_check_exclusion, ny_omig_check_exclusion and ca_medical_check_exclusion. Answers "is this provider on the Michigan Medicaid sanction list", "check this NPI against Michigan sanctions", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for a Michigan Medicaid provider. An NPI or license-number match is an IDENTIFICATION; a name match, even an exact one, is a CANDIDATE lead only (no date of birth is published). Each match carries the sanction date and source, a second sanction date and source where present (often the action being lifted), the provider category and MDHHS's free-text reason (blank on about 60% of rows). The response leads with counts by sanction source. City is served for businesses only; no street addresses. Sourced from MDHHS, keyless.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "1st Priority Physical Therapy" or "Oshiyoye". Any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification. Always pass it when known.

license.description: Michigan professional license number, if known. A license match is an identification.

tools.name: mi_medical_exclusion_coverage
tools.description: What the Michigan MDHHS List of Sanctioned Providers covers and how current it is: total rows, counts by sanction source (MDHHS, MDHHS-OIG, LARA, DCH, HHS), individuals vs businesses, how many carry an NPI, license number or reason, oldest and newest sanction date, and the list's own publication date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough before a compliance decision. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many sanctions have a sanction date in that year or range, counted over the whole list rather than a page, split by sanction source. The response names the date field counted (sanction_date, the first Sanction Date column, never the second date). Sourced from MDHHS, keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mi-medical-exclusions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mi-medical-exclusions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
